title: Meta Outperforms Open Rivals with Muse Glimmer 30B Model for Consumer PCs

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A newly released technical report describes an AI model that achieves operational efficiency on Mac or PC hardware using 4-bit quantization. Meta's Muse Glimmer is an open-weight model with 30B parameters specifically built for agentic tasks on consumer devices, running at practical speeds on a single consumer GPU. The model outperforms similarly sized open rivals in multi-step planning and tool use.

The development process involved training agents within simulated digital lives containing 10-14 contacts and weeks of messages, calendars, and documents. Agents practiced tasks over multiple days, while the company discarded training trajectories that contained hallucinated results or unverified claims of success. The published report also details the model's quantization, distillation recipe, and architecture.

Today we published a technical report on Muse Glimmer, our 30B open-weight model built for agentic tasks on consumer hardware.

It runs at practical speeds on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU at 4-bit precision, and leads comparably-sized open models on tool use and multi-step planning.
